## Resolved dependencies and binary distribution

`pubspec.lock` records the package versions. Dependencies are resolved by Flutter and are not vendored source in this repository. Flutter and Dart runtime libraries, `crypto`, test tools and their transitive dependencies retain their respective licenses. The normal client requires a media SDK; the current development SDK depends on `flutter_webrtc`. Its upstream license and NOTICE remain applicable, and the private SDK implementation is not covered by this repository's Apache license.

For binary releases, include the exact resolved Flutter/Dart and transitive dependency license notices (Flutter generates `NOTICES.Z` in the application assets). The source notices here are not a substitute for an inventory of all binaries in an eventual installer.

## Assets

The application and tray icons are project assets generated by `tool/generate_brand_icons.py` from the approved, font-free SVG geometry in [assets/brand](assets/brand/README.md). These replace the original extracted icons; source and generated artifact hashes are recorded in that directory. The project-specific geometry is included within the project's Apache-2.0 asset scope. No permission to impersonate the official project is implied.

Brand wordmark outlines derive from Adobe Source Han Sans CN and Inter Tight. Their exact versions, fixed upstream sources, checksums and reproduction procedure are recorded in [assets/brand/WORDMARK.md](assets/brand/WORDMARK.md). Preserve the complete [Source Han Sans OFL-1.1](LICENSES/SourceHanSans-OFL-1.1.txt) and [Inter Tight OFL-1.1](LICENSES/InterTight-OFL-1.1.txt) notices with these sources. No font binaries are bundled: the application uses generated vector outlines for the brand lettering, and system font fallbacks for body text. The outlines are not a modified redistributable font package.

## Short-code connection dependencies

The local connection package resolves `cryptography` 2.9.0 (Apache-2.0) and `pointycastle` 4.0.0 (Bouncy Castle / MIT-style license) from pub.dev. Their sources are not vendored; preserve the resolved package LICENSE files and generated Flutter notices when distributing binaries. SRP, Ed25519, HKDF and AES-GCM implementations remain upstream dependencies.
